senses.gloss: f. (נָסַע; cmp. b. h. שִׂיא fr. נָשָׂא) travelling company, escort.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 1:9:2">Y. Keth. I, 25ᵈ</cite> <he>ס׳ של כהנים עוברת</he> a troop of priests passed the place; Bab.
<cite ref="Ketubot 15a:1">Keth. 15ᵃ</cite> <he>ס׳ של … כשרין</he> a party of men of unblemished descent.
<cite ref="Ketubot 15a:5">Ib.</cite> <he>רוב ס׳</he> the majority of transients.
Shebu. 35ᵃ ראה ס׳ של וכ׳ if he saw a troop of people standing and his witnesses among them; Arakh. 18ᵃ סִיאָה; a. fr.—In gen. company, followers.
<cite ref="Gittin 76b:19">Gitt. 76ᵇ</cite> <he>ולא הודו לו כל סִיעָתוֹ</he> none of his followers (disciples) agreed with him.
<cite ref="Berakhot 17b:1">Ber. 17ᵇ</cite> <he>שלא תהא סִיעָתֵינוּ כסיעתו וכ׳</he> that our following be not like that of David; a. fr.—Pl. <he>סִיעוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Demai 4:5:4">Y. Dem. IV, end, 24ᵇ</cite>; a. e.
